findings.message: Changing 'completed / total * 100' to 'completed // total * 100' makes the function floor-divide before multiplying by 100, so any completed < total returns 0.0 (e.g. 1/3 -> 0 instead of ~33.33) and it also violates the float return type.
findings.suggestion: Revert to 'return completed / total * 100' (or use round(completed / total * 100, ...) if a rounded value is desired).
